title: Governed screening workflow
claim_boundary: Source-implemented and compiler-verified across screening state machines, role assignments, blinding projections, criteria enforcement, amendment flows and review tool adapters. Phase 3 higher-evidence gate uses a structured agent-panel protocol simulating information specialists and methodologists; panel output is fixture-proven, not a substitute for live human studies. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.
